channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from morningNewsSection1, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: SNAP fraud steals millions from recipients, report says
item.description: Organized crime rings target SNAP recipients due to outdated security features. Upgrading the technology would cost money and effort.

item.title: Kimberly Guilfoyle resigns as ambassador to Greece
item.description: The White House requested the resignation of U.S. Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle on Tuesday amid mounting accusations of improper conduct.

item.title: Workers train robots that may replace them
item.description: Factory workers in India wear GoPro cameras to record their tasks. The goal is to train robots to take over their jobs.

item.title: Free skincare samples can lead to costly charges
item.description: Customers have long reported aggressive sales tactics and unexpected charges at mall skincare stores. NPR investigated the business connecting many of them.
